Wind & weather data [W]

Open-Meteo Forecast API · Best Match. Wind is at 10 m; gust values are preceding-hour maxima. Knots are calculated from the requested km/h using kn = km/h ÷ 1.852. Visibility is converted from metres to kilometres. UV, precipitation and sunrise/sunset come from this same response. [W]
